name: Journey to the Marsh
summary: Your class sends you to Dustwallow Marsh to speak with Tabetha. Her knowledge is the first step toward earning your wand.

sections.title: Tabetha’s Cottage
sections.body: Tabetha lives in a cottage west of Theramore and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins. You are asked to speak with the hermit and learn from her vast knowledge.

faq.answer: Tabetha is a hermit in Dustwallow Marsh, known for her vast knowledge.
Tabetha’s cottage is west of Theramore and just north of the Stonemaul Ruins.

faq.q: Why am I being sent to Tabetha?
faq.answer: Speaking with Tabetha begins your effort to earn your class’s wand.
